title: fast-vollib: accelerated derivatives pricing, portfolio P&L, and Monte Carlo simulation with NumPy, PyTorch, and JAX
description:
fast-vollib is an accelerated — kernel-fused, optimized — Python library for Black, Black-Scholes, and Black-Scholes-Merton pricing, implied volatility, Greeks, observation-backed listed-option P&L, typed derivative contracts, and explicit Monte Carlo workflows. P&L workflows include Decimal FIFO accounting, exact terminal payoff metrics, explicit quote indications, European horizon valuation and retained fixed-grid forecasts. It provides pluggable NumPy, PyTorch, and JAX backends and a compatibility-first functional API modeled on py_vollib_vectorized.

Documentation: raeidsaqur.github.io/fast-vollib
